# Vivistim

> Vivistim is an FDA-approved medical device combining vagus nerve stimulation with rehabilitation therapy for post-stroke upper limb recovery.

Vivistim pairs innovative VNS (vagus nerve stimulation) technology with intensive rehabilitation to help stroke survivors regain arm and hand function. The platform serves patients, implanting physicians, therapists, and healthcare providers with clinical evidence, training resources, and comprehensive support throughout the patient journey.

## Key Topics

- Paired VNS Therapy
- Vagus Nerve Stimulation (VNS)
- Stroke Recovery
- Upper Limb Rehabilitation
- Neuroplasticity
- FDA-Approved Medical Device
- Implant Procedure
- Clinical Evidence
- MicroTransponder
- Vivistim System
- Medicare/Medicaid Coverage
- Rehabilitation Therapy
- Post-Stroke Recovery
